mapper.select: SELECT (d.delivered_at - d.proposed_date) AS days FROM biz_demand d WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND d.proposed_date IS NOT NULL AND d.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND d.delivery_mark IN #{m}
SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS cnt FROM dtl_course_review r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.record_state = #{completedState} GROUP BY r.course_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_result = #{passResult}) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator FROM dtl_course_review r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.round_no = 1 AND r.record_state = #{completedState}
SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS cnt FROM dtl_course_trial t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.record_state = #{completedState} GROUP BY t.course_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.course_conclusion = #{qualifiedConclusion}) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator FROM dtl_course_trial t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.round_no = 1 AND t.record_state = #{completedState}
SELECT (c.published_at::DATE - c.created_at::DATE) AS days FROM biz_case c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE AND c.case_state = #{publishedState} AND c.published_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE p.actual_finish_date IS NOT NULL AND p.actual_finish_date <= p.plan_end_date ) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator FROM biz_training_plan p WHERE p.deleted = FALSE AND p.plan_state = #{completedState}

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', hit.hit_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "monthKey", AVG(hit.days)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "avgDays" FROM ( SELECT (MIN(l.changed_at)::DATE - d.proposed_date) AS days, MIN(l.changed_at)::DATE AS hit_date FROM biz_demand d JOIN audit_state_log l ON l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.object_id = d.id AND l.state_field = #{stateField} AND l.to_state = #{toState} WHERE d.deleted = FALSE AND d.proposed_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.proposed_date ) hit WHERE hit.hit_date >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', hit.hit_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "monthKey", AVG(hit.days)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "avgDays" FROM ( SELECT (MIN(l.changed_at)::DATE - c.initiated_date) AS days, MIN(l.changed_at)::DATE AS hit_date FROM biz_course c JOIN audit_state_log l ON l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.object_id = c.id AND l.state_field = #{stateField} AND l.to_state = #{toState} WHERE c.deleted = FALSE AND c.initiated_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.id, c.initiated_date ) hit WHERE hit.hit_date >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', r.review_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "monthKey", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_result = #{passResult}) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator FROM dtl_course_review r WHERE r.deleted = FALSE AND r.round_no = 1 AND r.record_state = #{completedState} AND r.review_date >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', t.trial_date), 'YYYY-MM') AS "monthKey", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.course_conclusion = #{qualifiedConclusion}) AS numerator, COUNT(*) AS denominator FROM dtl_course_trial t WHERE t.deleted = FALSE AND t.round_no = 1 AND t.record_state = #{completedState} AND t.trial_date >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', c.published_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS "monthKey", AVG((c.published_at::DATE - c.created_at::DATE))::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "avgDays" FROM biz_case c WHERE c.deleted = FALSE AND c.case_state = #{publishedState} AND c.published_at IS NOT NULL AND c.published_at::DATE >= #{fromMonth} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
